remaining_tasks.name: Replace Iteration-0 provisional resource ceilings with measured floors
Phase close-out: last uncapped container, architecture docs, diagrams, todo closure

decisions.decision: Worktree isolation auto-degrades to sequential (none) for this run
decisions.rationale: local main is repeatedly ahead of origin/main (12+ unpushed commits); Claude Code forks worktrees from origin/HEAD, so isolated dispatch would miss recent work (#48/#3659). Re-check dispatch-isolation sentinel each wave — it drifts back to harness-worktree between dispatches and must be re-forced to none.

decisions.decision: Orchestrator performs VM deploy steps directly (not the executor subagent) once the human gives DIRECT authorization in-conversation
decisions.rationale: the gsd-executor subagent correctly refuses to treat an orchestrator-relayed 'user confirmed X' as genuine consent for irreversible production actions (SSH deploy, credential handling) — this is by design, not a bug. The orchestrator holds the real first-party authorization from its own conversation with the human, so it should act directly rather than relay through a subagent a second time.

decisions.decision: Never read, generate, or pass a real secret/credential value as a CLI argument or print it; hand credential-touching verification steps to the human
decisions.rationale: during 12-01, an orchestrator-run `docker exec ... --password=X` leaked the raw Grafana admin password into `docker events`' logged command line and into the session transcript. Remediated by rotation (twice — once by the orchestrator, then the human independently via `pass`). Established going forward: read secrets from a container's own live env (never re-parse a VM's .env file, which may carry literal quote characters as part of the value), pipe values via stdin never argv, and default to asking the human to run any login/credential-verification step themselves.

decisions.decision: Loki schema_config.from and limits_config.reject_old_samples_max_age must be set safely before any container's on-disk log backlog, not the deploy date
decisions.rationale: 12-02's first deploy hit two related bugs: a schema `from:` of 'today' turned every pre-deploy log line into a hard 500 that Promtail retried forever, blocking two Redpanda streams entirely; then even after backdating the schema, the default 7-day reject_old_samples_max_age caused whole-batch drops that took a third, genuinely-recent stream (kanban-nonprod-app) down as collateral damage. Fixed by setting both schema `from:` (2024-01-01) and reject_old_samples_max_age (720h) to match the actual 30-day retention policy. A third, distinct issue (a too_far_behind per-stream guard tied to max_chunk_age) also surfaced for a genuinely-idle container and was fixed by the executor with a one-off `docker restart` — documented in docs/INFRA_RUNBOOK.md.

next_action: Run /gsd-execute-phase 12 to continue with Wave 3 (plan 12-03: cAdvisor + postgres_exporter). Re-check the .gsd/dispatch-isolation-sentinel.json state before dispatching — it drifts back to harness-worktree between waves and must be re-forced to none with `gsd_run query dispatch-isolation --raw --phase 12 --force-isolation none` as long as main stays ahead of origin/main.
context_notes: Waves 1-2 of 6 done, both required real production VM deploys the orchestrator performed directly (with explicit human authorization each time, never via a relayed subagent message) over SSH to netcup-prod. Both plans surfaced and fixed real bugs during live verification rather than rubber-stamping static config checks — this phase's pattern so far is: deploy, verify end-to-end against real running state, fix what's actually broken, re-verify. Expect 12-03 (cAdvisor + postgres_exporter) to need the same VM-deploy authorization dance. No outstanding blockers or pending human actions — phase is in a clean, fully-committed state to resume from.
